citation: Macke, Berens, Ecker, Tolias & Bethge, Neural Computation 21(2):397-423, 2009
conditioning: gct via per-assay site propensity and per-assay base rate; lct via log-rate regression on all 9 clip features
notes: Stationary form: a full 26880^2 covariance is unestimable at 1.55e-4 voxel rate. Latent correlations obtained by inverting the DG joint-exceedance relation, not by using binary correlations directly.

regimes.random: gct and lct both drawn unconditionally from the train bank
regimes.global_only: gct pinned; lct retrieved conditioned on gct
regimes.global_partial_local: gct pinned; ['log_mean_firing_density', 'active_site_ratio'] pinned exactly; rest retrieved
regimes.global_full_local: gct and lct both pinned to the held-out clip
